summary: The prepared main revision already supports MXFP6 E2M3 as the A operand of the gfx950 preshuffle GEMM. The unmodified checkout passed the reported W4A6 path. This change strengthens its targeted correctness coverage by independently decoding the exact packed MXFP6 A bytes, packed MXFP4 B bytes, and E8M0 scales before an fp32 torch.matmul reference; it does not change the kernel or existing MXFP4 behavior.

tests.what_was_measured: Unmodified-checkout reproduction on gfx950: the MXFP6-A/MXFP4-B kernel compiled and matched the then-current dequantization-plus-matmul reference; 147.29 TFLOP/s was printed. Raw output: reports/j-971b1e7c1b24/raw/a6w4-before.txt

The independent packed-byte oracle passed W4A6 for bf16 with tile_k=256 and fp16 with tile_k=128; the existing MXFP4-A/MXFP4-B bf16 case also passed. Raw output: reports/j-971b1e7c1b24/raw/focused-after.txt

Cache-disabled gfx950 compilation and numerical execution passed. Final ISA contains 16 v_mfma_scale_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4 instructions and targets gfx950. Raw output: reports/j-971b1e7c1b24/raw/a6w4-isa-run.txt; ISA evidence: reports/j-971b1e7c1b24/raw/isa-evidence.txt; full compiler dumps: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-971b1e7c1b24/mxfp6-isa-final/kernel_gemm_0

gpu_execution_evidence: All correctness runs executed on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), and the cache-disabled final ISA declares amdgcn-amd-amdhsa-unknown-gfx950.
remaining_limitations: No implementation defect was reproducible at the recorded base, so there is no failing-before/passing-after kernel fix. No native rebuild was needed because only Python test coverage changed. Validation was focused on gfx950 W4A6 bf16/fp16 and one MXFP4 preservation case rather than the full large-shape matrix. The prepared checkout is shallow/grafted, so the historical upstream commit named by the issue was not locally available for comparison.
